And with a Paypal, I don’t care if they’re liberal or conservative, if they’re religious or judgmental. But they three things have to be really clicking. We talk on a lot of different levels. We talk deep and we have dinner dates. I ask it’s not about money or success. It’s whether they’re able to be kind.
